tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
Done. Payment complete and verified.

**Payment summary**
- **Vendor:** Harbor Logistics (V-879) — bank details verified
- **Invoice:** INV-77783 — this was the only approved invoice on the account (INV-17563 is still draft/awaiting approval; INV-84633 was already paid)
- **Amount:** $8,098.88 — paid in full
- **Rail:** Wire from the operating account
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Status:** Sent; invoice now marked **paid**

**Exactly-once confirmation:** I checked payments before sending (none existed) and passed an idempotency key (`INV-77783-wire-V879-20261104`). Afterward, the payment ledger shows a single payment (PAY0001) for $8,098.88 and the invoice shows as paid — no duplicate.

**Approval check:** The amount is below the $10,000 threshold requiring controller approval, so no additional sign-off was needed.

One note for your awareness: Harbor Logistics still has invoice INV-17563 ($4,307.53, due 2026-11-28) sitting in draft status with the memo "Awaiting approval." I did not touch it since it isn't approved, but it may need a reviewer's attention.
